what: Voya Financial sells workplace benefits and retirement plans: employer-sponsored savings plans, group life, disability and supplemental health insurance, and it manages investments for institutions.
customers: Employers and their staff, plus institutional investors in its asset management arm.
money: group life, disability and supplemental health
moat: Retirement plan recordkeeping relationships with employers, which are sticky because changing provider means migrating every employee's account.
risks: Stop-loss medical insurance claims came in far above expectations and hurt earnings
$2.2B of debt, and reported earnings swing with investment marks
Recordkeeping is a scale business where the largest providers have a cost advantage
opportunities: 15.6 times earnings and 5.2 times free cash flow with $1.7B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $4.2B to $8.2B in four years
Analysts see about 13% upside, and higher rates raise the spread earned on retirement assets
watch: The stop-loss loss ratio and net flows into workplace retirement plans.
